Agent Name: Planner

, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Apple Records is part of Universal Music Group by conflating distribution (EMI → UMG) with corporate ownership. “Part of” in this context refers to the parent company, which is Apple Corps Ltd., not UMG. This misreading of sources led to the wrong interim conclusion.
